crew.overview: The extraordinary tale of Harriet Tubman's escape from slavery and transformation into one of America's greatest heroes. Her courage, ingenuity and tenacity freed hundreds of slaves and changed the course of history.
crew.title: Harriet

details.biography:
Emmy & CAS nominated Sound Mixer working in the Mid-Atlantic Region and beyond. Location sound mixing and recording is my passion. I've been working in film and television sound for over 20+ years. I understand the importance of teamwork and creative thinking in the process of film and television production. My experience covers the gamut of film, television and new media production genres .

William Britt C.A.S.
